semiconductor_relevance: High — Techno Quartz provides essential materials and components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Techno Quartz specializes in high-precision quartz glass, silicon, and ceramic products crucial for semiconductor and LCD manufacturing equipment. They offer quartz ware, including Silicon Carbide, Fused Quartz Glass, and Sapphire, as well as ceramic and oxide ceramic fixtures. Their services include manufacturing chucks for wafers and substrates, and providing etching, stripping, and cleaning services.
